title: The trust decision is read and recorded through Pi's exported store, and an unapproved project never launches an agent
statement: The trust decision for this project is read, granted, denied and revoked through `ProjectTrustStore` as exported from the pinned package's root, keyed by the canonical project directory, with no write to Pi's trust file shape and no import of an unexported path. A project with no decision and a project that was denied are distinct outcomes, never collapsed into one. An agent launch over a project whose trust is not approved is refused BEFORE the child is spawned, the planning scaffold is left untouched by that refusal, and the refusal names `bin/start-shell.mjs` as the browser-only way to carry on without an agent.
notes: ⚠️ NARROWED TO WHAT TSK-0032 BUILDS. The criterion asked for interactive setup to display the path and obtain the decision, for `--trust approve`, and for a non-interactive refusal - none of which can exist before the setup command does. Those moved to the criterion on TSK-0060. What is left is the module and the launch gate, which are this task's to deliver and can be tested today. ⚠️ THE STORE IS THE BOUNDARY. DEC-0027 withdrew writing `trust.json` directly; depending on the exported class is the whole of the difference, so 'through the exported store' is part of the assertion rather than an implementation note. ⚠️ MISSING IS NOT DENIED. An absent decision is a project nobody has been asked about; a denial is an operator's answer. Setup may ask about the first and must not re-ask about the second, so a module that reported both as 'not trusted' would make that impossible one layer up.
